summary.text: Greg Markkanen, listed by Ballotpedia as Gregory Markkanen, is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 110, which he has held since January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Markkanen took office in the state House in 2019, succeeding Democrat Scott Dianda, who held District 110 before him.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, and for 2023-2024 he served on the Education and Financial Services committees and as Minority Vice Chair of the Military, Veterans and Homeland Security Committee.
